conclusion: Verified by FH primary data: October 2026 Swiss watch exports +9.1% to CHF 2.46bn, fifth straight monthly rise; YTD ~CHF 22bn (+3.4%). Steel and gold-steel led; the US +60.8% is a tariff base effect and France's +101.6% is re-exports. FH itself cautions that margins are under pressure, so the post must carry that context.
